providerInput: developer-authored prompt with closed fictional biology values and bounded numerical or hexadecimal visual values
optional game-captured synthetic creature reference image
notProviderInput: free-text trait descriptions, quirks or effects
unrecognised trait labels, features, mutations or ability strings
portrait.unknownTraits: Use a generic authored category or omit the unsupported optional feature in the model prompt only. Never edit saved genetics, labels, family relationships, cache keys or the source spec.
portrait.compatibility: Frozen 96-case prompt hashes from the released baseline cover ordinary, shiny/mutated and legacy-no-DNA creatures, four stages, four styles, with and without a reference image. Source-derived domain tests cover all currently authored DNA, genetics, feature and mutation choices.

publication.durability: GameState stages the existing v2 active-creature and roster portrait fields with detached accounting. The existing verified local writer must confirm exact bytes before adoption or ready events. A refused save must not publish optional portrait data in canonical memory.
publication.deferredResult: LivingPortraitService keeps at most 32 opaque processing or ready results in this tab, bound to the exact game, story, reset and cloud owner. A save hold does not retire that custody. Retry first adopts the same result or resolves its existing asset with GET, without posting another generation.
publication.retirement: Reset, restored story tree, game owner, cloud owner, cloud user or unrelated cloud campaign changes invalidate old work and temporary results. Only exact admission-correlated counter changes from the attached existing cloud manager preserve hold/release custody. Ordinary creature switches preserve the original result without publishing over the selected creature. Old finalisers cannot delete replacement jobs or resolutions.
publication.initialSession: Before the first request, the original media client may bind only its authenticated initial anonymous session. A delayed cloud notification must match that session. Explicit SIGNED_OUT retires pending authentication even when the cloud user is still null; later results cannot revive that context. Observed ownership rejection is irreversible. Auth subscriptions are retired with the context. Another established owner, client, reset or unrelated campaign cannot borrow it.
publication.failure: Blocked publication is retryable portrait_save_deferred, not generation success or failure. No new portrait request starts while save admission is held, storage is memory-only or a cloud write is active. A new generation remains possible after an explicitly failed existing provider job, using the unchanged retry contract.
publication.limits: Temporary custody is not durable: closing the tab, reset, owner change or bounded eviction can discard an unpublished result. Already-sent requests cannot be revoked. This private synthetic qualification does not establish live provider or migration acceptance.

firstForestPreparation.trigger: A successfully saved active-creature portrait starts the existing first_forest_arrival preparation helper without needing a reveal screen to remain open.
firstForestPreparation.latePortrait: Seeing the authored Forest intro or a moving portrait is not a generated-film viewing receipt. A late first portrait can still prepare the unseen film while the Forest is unfinished.
suppressed: same creature's generated arrival film already viewed
portrait replaced or no longer active
existing failed or cancelled job: no automatic paid resubmission
firstForestPreparation.presentation: LivingFormHandoff delegates to the same helper. Existing in-flight job de-duplication, feature switches, quotas and optional Watch/archive delivery remain unchanged.
firstForestPreparation.failureIsolation: Optional video errors cannot change a successfully saved portrait job into a failure.

publication.writer: GameState.saveCompanionMedia stages the existing v2 companion-media data and accounting through the exact-byte verified writer. Live story data and change/ready/watched notifications are not exposed before verification.
publication.storyOwnership: Only the trusted verified-publication callback reuses the original story root with identical verified media metadata. During that synchronous writer only, its own exact original/detached-root fence owns the temporary story root; game/cloud/admission/active-identity fences remain enforced. Async guards always require their original story root. Unrelated story and creature branches remain untouched so in-flight jobs keep their legitimate session ownership.
publication.postCommitChanges: A listener may retire, hold or change the current game after verification. The old call cannot announce success, roll back the committed receipt or overwrite the successor. A post-commit hold is not an uncommitted write failure.
publication.temporaryResults: Volatile video responses are internal retry custody, not Watch-ready notices. A refused result resumes its existing asset with GET; only committed canonical ready metadata is listed as ready to watch.
publication.restoreOwnership: Unpublished responses belong to their original story root as well as game/cloud ownership. Restoring a save retires the old story's cache and callbacks. Normal verified media publication preserves that root; creature switches within the same campaign remain supported.
publication.requestAdmission: No new video request or authentication lookup is started while save admission is held, storage is memory-only or a cloud write is active. Publication refusal returns no ready response and retains the existing opaque result for later retry.
publication.authority: These are client-side correctness checks only. Server authentication, ownership, idempotency and quota enforcement remain authoritative and unchanged. This is not proof of provider availability, physical-phone playback or native migration acceptance.

providerInput: developer-authored scene text selected by moment and known realm
video.browserText: Moment suffixes, player names, creature names, account identifiers and save history must never be interpolated into provider prompt text.
video.changesInThisSlice: First-Forest trigger and optional-error isolation only. Existing video configuration, templates, provider selection and request shapes are not changed.

reviewBoundaries.contractCoordination: Operations notified before implementation; this safeguard is a dependency for the migration AI boundary, not proof that migration is qualified.
reviewBoundaries.imageLimitation: Text projection does not prove that arbitrary forged PNG input depicts only fictional creatures. Normal app capture has no player-photo input; semantic image-origin enforcement remains a separate security review.
reviewBoundaries.creativeLimitation: Prompt parity and schema tests do not approve generated image quality, physical-device playback, provider availability or legal compliance.
